title: Raymond de la Nézière, Animal Artist
content: Raymond de la Nézière (1865-1953) was a French illustrator and comic artist with a gift for capturing expressive poses in animal caricature.He began drawing and painting from a young age, encouraged by his mother, who was a painter and potter.In his early years he painted in oil and then began using more gouache and watercolor.He illustrated many books and sketched all sorts of animals, sometimes in naturalistic poses, and sometimes anthroporphized as human types.He also participated as a hunter and a horseback rider.
